name: generalization-v3
description: Blind generalization set (TAH-140). Questions and expected answers written by an isolated agent from a neutral specification, without the parser, earlier datasets or system outputs; numeric goldens verified by independent SQL and Python oracles; reviewed by a second isolated agent. Never run before freezing.
seed: app/rag/evaluation/seed.py (20 payments of the main merchant, 2 of the other tenant, October 2026, EUR)

cases.question: Cosa vuol dire lo stato creation_unknown?

readings.meaning: Meaning of the creation_unknown status.

cases.question: What's the difference between failed and expired?

golden.intended_meaning: Difference between failed and expired statuses.

readings.meaning: Difference between failed and expired statuses.

key_facts: expired: Stripe reports the session expired
failed: definitive rejection on first attempt, async payment failure, failed verification, or session proven never created
both final, but can go to paid only with verified Stripe data

cases.question: How does reconciliation work? how often does it check my payments?

golden.intended_meaning: How and when reconciliation runs.

readings.meaning: How and when reconciliation runs.

key_facts: every non-final payment has a next_reconcile_at
open first checked after 15 minutes, never later than expires_at + 5 min
exponential backoff base x 2^attempts, 60 s default, capped at 6 h, ±20% jitter

cases.question: se la connessione cade mentre creo un pagamento e io riprovo, rischio che il cliente paghi due volte?

readings.meaning: How idempotency prevents double payments on retry.

key_facts: no, if the retry reuses the same Idempotency-Key

cases.question: Un errore di rete può far fallire un pagamento?

readings.meaning: Whether a network error leads to failed.
